channel.title: 我嘅每日話題
channel.description: 每日精選時事、商業、股市、宇宙、科技話題

item.title: Arabica Coffee Prices Hit Record on U.S., Colombia Tariff Spat
item.description: Arabica coffee prices hit a record level, as traders digested the withdrawal of President Trump’s threats to impose tariffs and economic sanctions on Colombia.

item.title: Financial Services Roundup: Market Talk
item.description: Gain insight on Experian, SoFi Technologies and more in the latest Market Talks covering Financial Services.

item.title: DeepSeek Won't Sink U.S. AI Titans
item.description: Panic fueling the selloff of Nvidia, Broadcom and other tech giants is overblown.

item.title: Comex Gold, Silver Settle Lower
item.description: Gold settled 1.4% lower, down two of the past three sessions, and silver fell 2.5%, down three of the past four sessions.

item.title: Stocks Sink in Broad AI Rout Sparked by China's DeepSeek
item.description: U.S. stocks were mostly lower, with the Nasdaq leading declines as makers of AI infrastructure suffered steep falls, many in the double digits. Nvidia was down 16%.

item.title: Palo Alto Networks in talks to buy AI agent security startup Clutch for $500M
item.description: Clutch, backed by Lightspeed and SignalFire, was last valued at $85 million, according to a source.

item.title: At least 10 local governments have moved to drop Flock’s surveillance cameras since summer
item.description: The concerns range from privacy to how data is shared (and with whom) to procurement concerns.

item.title: Tesla will stop making the Cybertruck in 2027
item.description: The decision to wind down the EV comes after just a few short years of underwhelming sales. Elon Musk said the company will use the factory space to make more Cybercabs.

item.title: Physicl raises $10M to make the digital world real enough for robots
item.description: Physicl is trying to solve the sim-to-real gap with a pipeline originally built to market goods online.

item.title: Underdog shows off a 32MB speech model in new demo
item.description: Despite its small size, Underdog's new model can generate both speech and music.

item.title: After blocking Muse, Amazon now lets users text Alexa to help them shop
item.description: Amazon said that the feature will roll out to millions of users in coming weeks.

item.title: Ramp data shows AI spending stalling just as Anthropic nears its IPO
item.description: AI usage keeps climbing, but spending has stalled. Price cuts and smarter cost controls among the biggest spenders could challenge investor assumptions about AI hypergrowth.

item.title: Fox completes its $22B acquisition of Roku
item.description: A few months after DOJ investigators were probing the deal, Fox just completed its $22B acquisition of the streaming giant Roku.

item.title: Pentagon offers battery startup 6K $250M loan to build US factory
item.description: The Pentagon has conditionally approved a $250 million loan to help 6K scale up its microwave-plasma battery material manufacturing process.

item.description: Meta's Muse agents continue to get new features and integrations. Spaces promises to be a new way to interact with the AI helpers.

item.title: Hundreds of Artex AI hacking tools found publicly exposed to the web
